open_tasks.title: Debug a CrashLoopBackOff end-to-end
open_tasks.detail: Deliberately break a Deployment (bad probe, OOM limit, missing secret). For each, narrate the exact kubectl sequence you'd run and what output confirms the cause. Interviewers ask this constantly.

open_tasks.title: Reduce MTTD with a concrete plan
open_tasks.detail: You cut MTTD from 45 to under 10 minutes. Reconstruct exactly how, as a repeatable method: what you instrumented, what you alerted on, what you deleted.

open_tasks.title: Handle the scope question
open_tasks.detail: Senior roles probe blast radius: how many engineers were affected, what did you own end-to-end, what decision was yours alone. Write your honest answers.

open_tasks.title: Supply chain security
open_tasks.detail: SBOM generation, image signing (cosign), admission control on unsigned images, dependency pinning, and locking down the build runner itself.

open_tasks.title: LLMOps: deploy, monitor, iterate
open_tasks.detail: Versioning prompts, shadow testing, drift detection, feedback capture, and rollback. How is this different from deploying normal code?

open_tasks.title: Answer 'why are you leaving Accenture?'
open_tasks.detail: Forward-looking, specific, zero criticism of current employer. Write it, say it out loud, cut it to 30 seconds.

open_tasks.title: Secrets and Terraform
open_tasks.detail: Explain why secrets end up in state in plaintext, and the mitigations: encrypted backends, ephemeral resources, external secret managers, write-only arguments.

open_tasks.title: IAM policy evaluation logic
open_tasks.detail: Explicit deny > SCP > permission boundary > identity policy > resource policy. Work through a scenario where access is denied and you must name exactly which layer blocked it.

open_tasks.title: Write a blameless postmortem
open_tasks.detail: Use a real incident. Timeline, impact, detection gap, contributing factors, and action items with owners. No individual named as the cause.

open_tasks.title: Capacity and cost estimate
open_tasks.detail: For a service at 5k RPS: instance sizing, autoscaling headroom, data transfer, storage growth. Produce a monthly figure and defend the assumptions.

open_tasks.title: When NOT to use an LLM
open_tasks.detail: Write 6 scenarios where a script, a query, or a rules engine beats an LLM. Being able to say this is a senior signal.

open_tasks.title: SSM Session Manager vs bastion hosts
open_tasks.detail: You built an SSM-only access path. Write the security argument: no inbound ports, IAM-gated, fully audited. Name the trade-offs a sceptical reviewer would raise.

open_tasks.title: Build your 5 core STAR stories
open_tasks.detail: Conflict, failure, influence without authority, technical leadership, ambiguity. Use Infra Agent, the GitLab pipeline work, the DR rebuild, cost governance, and mentoring. 2 minutes each, with numbers.

open_tasks.title: GitOps with Argo CD
open_tasks.detail: Explain pull vs push deployment, drift reconciliation, app-of-apps, sync waves, and how you handle secrets and emergency manual changes.

open_tasks.title: Multi-account landing zone
open_tasks.detail: Sketch an Organizations layout: OUs, SCP guardrails, centralised logging, network account, break-glass access. Justify each boundary.

open_tasks.title: Pytest: fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch
open_tasks.detail: Write tests for an existing function using all three. Aim for real edge cases, not happy paths.

open_tasks.title: Terraform in CI/CD safely
open_tasks.detail: Design the pipeline: plan on PR with output posted as a comment, gated apply on merge, OIDC auth instead of static keys, state locking, and policy-as-code (OPA/Sentinel) gates.

open_tasks.title: Metrics vs logs vs traces
open_tasks.detail: When does each answer a question the others can't? Explain cardinality explosion and why it destroys a metrics backend.

open_tasks.title: MCP and tool interoperability
open_tasks.detail: Explain the Model Context Protocol: what problem it solves, the client/server split, and how you'd expose your existing Python tools through it.

open_tasks.title: Design a CI/CD platform for 200 engineers
open_tasks.detail: Self-service onboarding, golden paths, guardrails, runner capacity, cost attribution, and multi-tenancy isolation.

open_tasks.title: VPC design from scratch
open_tasks.detail: Design a 3-AZ VPC: CIDR sizing, public/private/isolated subnets, NAT strategy and cost, route tables, VPC endpoints (gateway vs interface), and the security group vs NACL distinction.

issues: Too long (1034 words, roughly 2+ pages). Trim to one page unless you have 10+ years of experience.
No GitHub/portfolio link. For engineering roles this is expected.
1 bullet(s) exceed ~32 words. Keep each to 1-2 lines.
wins: Strong action verbs used: architected, automated, built, designed, owned, reduced.
